findings.title: The current V1RC records' code binding is triggered at the file level
findings.detail: The question frames the V1X-RUN-HR condition as 'a change to the heart-rate paths requires recheck'. That wording is the first record (SSCTR-V1RC-REVIEW-r1, bound to earlier bytes 9f2cf47d..., enabling nothing now). The records in force (SSCTR-V1RC-RECHECK-r1: CAPACITY, and PACE/HR/ESTIMATE 'bound to the runtime hashes named in the CAPACITY record') are bound to src/v1-run-calibration.mjs sha256 0eae6521... and say 'a change to any of them requires a new independent SSCTR check'. The base file is exactly 0eae6521...; the candidate makes it d3e20f14.... BASELINE_AUDIT.md 5.2 quotes only the superseded wording. The runtime does not check code hashes (runCalibrationAuthority checks the values sha only), so this is a governance binding, not a runtime one.
findings.evidence: heartRateOf, fold, floorOf, classify and readEvidence are byte-identical; the change is an import, one extracted const with the identical expression, the additive five-zone computation and one added key; regression ADDITIVE_ONLY (326 steps, 0 unexplained); on/off invariance probes identical. As an independent SSCTR instance I find no change to CAPACITY, PACE, HR or ESTIMATE behaviour from this delta.
findings.disposition: Not blocking the five-zone boundary (it is inert unless CAPACITY and HR are valid). Chief must route the V1RC recheck to confirm or remove the four RECHECK-r1 records for d3e20f14... before integration; this review's evidence is an input to it. This review does not edit SSCTR_V1RC_RUN_RECORDS.json.

findings.title: Session roles do not see the run calibration's HR boundary
findings.detail: sessionHeartRate receives auth5 but not on.HR. With HR off and the five-zone authority on, cue families are NONE with the zones' reason EXTENSION_NOT_ENABLED (correct), but NO_GUIDANCE families report their family reason (e.g. ZONES_ARE_NOT_INDIVIDUAL_THRESHOLDS) rather than EXTENSION_NOT_ENABLED. Also the hold and authority checks are in opposite order in fiveZonesOf and sessionHeartRate (disabled plus hold: zones say HOLD_NO_PRESCRIPTION, sessions say EXTENSION_NOT_ENABLED). No cue is ever produced without zones; reason typing only.
findings.disposition: Fix in a later cycle if Product reads the reason; no sporting effect.

findings.title: Prototype-key family names fail closed with a different reason
findings.detail: U.families[p.family] on a family named constructor, __proto__ or toString returns an inherited value, giving NONE / UNKNOWN_ROLE instead of NO_HEART_RATE_GUIDANCE / UNKNOWN_FAMILY_FAIL_CLOSED. Fails closed (no cue). Families come from the planner catalogue, not from athletes.
findings.disposition: Use an own-property lookup (Object.hasOwn) in a later cycle.

findings.title: lab.modality is acceptable for the sporting rule, as a declaration only
findings.detail: The field sits inside the existing free-form lab object, is carried whole by readEvidence (unchanged) and survives the integration boundary (probe3). It is normalised (trim, upper case, spaces/hyphens to underscore) and matched against RUN, TREADMILL_RUN, FIELD_RUN; anything else or absent gives LAB_MODALITY_NOT_RUNNING_OR_UNKNOWN when nothing else qualifies, and otherwise the observed maximum is used. This meets REQUIRED_DECLARED (treadmill or field running) and fails closed (e.g. 'RUNNING' is refused). The sporting rule depends on the value being a real declaration.
findings.disposition: Condition: the modality is the athlete's or the lab report's declaration, never defaulted, pre-filled or inferred (e.g. from protocol text) by a client; Data and Product own its collection and the enum the client offers.

findings.title: A lab report with only a maximum does not qualify
findings.detail: The lab tier also applies the three-zone lab readability rule (protocol, source and a non-empty values list). A lab test that supplies only a maximum heart rate is not used, and the observed maximum (if any) is. This is conservative and consistent with 'existing lab rules apply', but Data/Product should know it when designing collection.

findings.title: Newer-runner disclosure depends on a known experience
findings.detail: NEWER_RUNNER is added for experience NONE or NOVICE (same set as the planner's stridesOptional). Unknown experience gets no disclosure; NONE athletes are in WALK_JOG mode, where there are no zones. The V1 intake requires run experience, so the gap is theoretical.
findings.disposition: If experience ever becomes optional, show the disclosure when it is unknown.

findings.title: Not sporting: answer shape and freeze record
findings.detail: Even with the boundary off, every runCalibration answer now carries heartRateFiveZones (UNAVAILABLE / EXTENSION_NOT_ENABLED, per-session NONE), so the calibration hash and the carried seal move (regression: allowed differences only). The full suite has one failure beyond the baseline, REPMILE-COACHINGCORE-V1-FINAL-RELEASE-FREEZE, reporting the four HR5 files as undeclared amendments and the bundle module as not the bound source.
findings.disposition: Routed to QRE/Engineering via Chief: a declared freeze amendment or successor record and contract acceptance before release. Outside this role.

findings.title: One cue per session in presentation
findings.detail: With an observed reference both outputs carry a slow-down threshold at the same bpm (Z4 from = HIGH from; verified equal for 140-220). With a qualifying lab (by the three-zone rule, any modality) the three-zone output shows the supplied values and no zones, while the five-zone output may show zones from a running lab, from the observed maximum (non-running lab), or REFERENCE_CONFLICT. No contradictory cue bpm is produced, but the two readings can look different.
findings.disposition: Condition carried from the decision's Product escalation: Product presents one cue per session, keeps disclosure meanings, no 'Olympiatoppen'/'Norwegian' naming, no health meaning.

findings.title: Future classifier is unwired and carries no approved numbers
findings.detail: classifySamples is called by nothing in the engine; it requires caller-supplied maxGapSeconds, minCoverageFraction and plausibleBpm (CLASSIFIER_LIMITS_NOT_SET otherwise); only CHEST_STRAP or ECG; gaps, artifacts and samples above 220 are unknown time, never interpolated; coverage always reported; sessionDistribution is UNAVAILABLE / NO_HEART_RATE_SERIES_IN_CONTRACT with fromAverageHeartRate false. The values file approves no numeric limit. Its existence is not an approval of any limit.
findings.disposition: A future series channel requires its own SSCTR and Data review before any output.

questions.question: Does the implementation match SSCTR-HR5-DECISION-r1 exactly?
answer: Zones and per-mille: values file Z1 <720, Z2 720-800, Z3 800-870, Z4 870-920, Z5 >=920, domains LOW/LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/HIGH, namedScale null, withinDomainSplitsHaveSportingRole false: equal to values.zones.

Arithmetic: floor((bpm x pm + 500)/1000) in integers on [from, to), boundary to the higher zone; integer reference inside 140-220 required; strictly increasing and contiguous or null (ZONE_BOUNDARIES_DEGENERATE). Worked examples reproduced.
Open ends: Z1 fromBpm null, Z5 toBpm null, enforced.

Lab tier: LAB_TEST, heartRate.maxBpm 140-220, CHEST_STRAP or ECG, RPE >= 8 reported, completed not false, tolerated not false, declared running modality (lab.modality, acceptable per R-04), 182 days, no declared break of 14 days or more since, after the hold/return floor; newest qualifying; supplied lab values are not mapped to zones; checkedByTheApp false.
Observed maximum: the filter is the same as heartRateOf (Q6(b) unchanged); only a deterministic id tie-break is added, which cannot change the bpm.

Conflict: only when both are in force; observed - lab > 5 -> UNAVAILABLE / REFERENCE_CONFLICT with labMaxBpm, labDate, labEvidenceId, observedMaxBpm, observedDate, observedEvidenceId, differenceBpm; lab above observed is not a conflict; no lower-wins.

Confidence: referenceConfidence LOW for both kinds, zoneModelConfidence LOW, estimated true, provenance fields present (kind, bpm, evidenceId, date, sensor, ageDays; protocol, source and modality for lab), notes per kind.

Session roles: the families table and unknownFamily equal the decision; strides on a session get NO_HEART_RATE_GUIDANCE / HEART_RATE_LAGS_SHORT_HARD_BOUTS; EASY_REESTABLISHMENT cue only outside WALK_JOG/RESTART/RETURN (the only other run mode is EASY) and only with zones.

Cue rules: cue at the lower bpm of Z4 for the reference in force; sustainedReadingOnly true; neverSpeedUp true; healthMeaning false; no usual zones per family; effortConflict EFFORT_GOVERNS_HEART_RATE_MAY_ONLY_SUGGEST_SLOWING.

Week boundary: the same cutoff/recordedOn rule as heartRateOf; later weeks use next week's reading, provisional; Q9 withdrawal via the shared floor (break >= 14 days, hold, return mode) and the lab break check; effort-only modes NONE / MODE_WALK_JOG_RESTART_RETURN; hold first, HOLD_NO_PRESCRIPTION.
Time in zone UNAVAILABLE / NO_HEART_RATE_SERIES_IN_CONTRACT; classifier unwired, no approved numbers (R-09).
Fail-closed authority: values only as pinned bytes; boundary on only with an independent enabling record bound to them and with CAPACITY and HR.

questions.question: Can any path make heart rate primary, a target, a gate, change a dose/progression/pace band/estimate/session guidance, fabricate zones, use age/HRR/average/optical/declared maxima, or suggest speeding up?
questions.answer: Nothing in the engine reads heartRateFiveZones (grep: only the module, its call site, its test and the mission's oracle/driver). sessionHeartRate is computed beside sessionGuidance from the same effortOnly value and writes only into hr5Sessions; the session guidance, plan, pace bands, estimates, capacity, assessment and every other answer key are byte-identical with the authority on versus off over nine athletes, a hold and a strength-only intake, and across 326 recorded boundary steps (production authorities). Zones are never produced without a qualifying lab or observed reference; age, profile maxima, average-only heart rate, optical sensors, personal bests, implausible or non-integer values and stale or pre-break references give typed UNAVAILABLE reasons. Every session output has primary false and effortGoverns true; no cue outside the five easy families; no text suggests speeding up. Extreme, invalid and conflicting inputs fail closed without throwing in the probes. Residual: reason-typing NOTES R-02 and R-03, no sporting effect.

questions.question: Is heartRateOf byte-identical to base, so the V1X-RUN-HR record's recheck condition is not triggered?
questions.answer: heartRateOf is byte-identical (sha256 of the function text 243f6eed... at both commits), as are fold, floorOf, classify and readEvidence, and the heartRateZones output expression. The heart-rate paths named by the superseded SSCTR-V1RC-REVIEW-r1 record are therefore unchanged. The records in force (SSCTR-V1RC-RECHECK-r1) bind the whole src/v1-run-calibration.mjs at 0eae6521..., which the candidate changes to d3e20f14...; their recheck condition is triggered at the file level although no V1RC behaviour changes. See R-01.

aeReview.adequacyAndNecessity: The change prescribes nothing; KEEP of every prescription is preserved by construction and verified by invariance probes.
aeReview.smallestSufficientChange: Additive reading beside the frozen three zones; no planner, dose or gate change.
aeReview.agencyAndExplainability: Effort governs; heart rate may only suggest slowing; references carry provenance and LOW confidence; conflict shows both values.
aeReview.clinicalBoundary: No health meaning; symptoms stay on the existing warning-sign route; medication or conditions that alter heart rate remain ASK / ELIGIBILITY_UNASSESSED for the clinical owner (not decided here).

confidence: MODERATE for implementation conformance (code read, directed tests, independent probes, regression); LOW for the physiological meaning of the zones, as in the decision.
conditions: Synthetic data only; no real athletes and no production use.
